payload.claim: The second criterion's citation-boundary rule is exceptionally intricate (quote/slash exclusions on both sides, a triple-double-quote override, and a left-to-right 'a slash only opens a citation if the id immediately before it was itself judged' chaining rule that cannot be expressed as a single independent regex — it needs a stateful scan). This is not a factual error in the spec, and the spec explicitly leaves the spelling to the cell, but a person should decide up front whether one cell, inside max_turns: 200 / budget_usd: 48 / max_attempts: 3, can plausibly land all of the enumerated boundary cases across criteria 1-3 correctly in a bounded number of attempts, given how fine-grained the wrong_versions lists are.
